description: Deliberately empty. Every event feed is registered once in today-match.json - the shared configured event-source registry - because these feeds carry live and not-started fixtures in the same file and each record's own status decides its tab: scanner/events.py routes on schedule status, not on which file a source was configured in. Listing them here as well made every source fetch and parse twice and doubled the candidate pool. No count is written here on purpose; the registry is the count.
